purpose: Compare magnitude, speed, depth dependence and noise across Bacon, Luke and Allen
frontend: DARTsort ibllikecmr with coherence gates retained and absolute HF-PSD bad-channel cutoff disabled identically for all datasets; native initial_detection only; full coverage; per-window denoiser
noise: 12 uniformly spaced 1-second samples/window; third-order 300-6000 Hz zero-phase; no reference, shank median, local median within 100um excluding self
restart: Only hash-sealed completed stages reusable. Interrupted stages refuse overwrite. No within-fit optimizer checkpoint.
revision_reason: Original absolute HF-PSD cutoff labeled 383 of 384 Bacon channels noisy and rejected the remaining reference channel as dead. Six-chunk direct audit with the absolute cutoff disabled retained 383 on each NP probe and 32 on each Allen shank. Preserve v1 unchanged; rerun all datasets with the common amended gate.
